effect.name: Deltarune Lighting System With Shadow (Texture)
effect.description: This is a recreation of the lighting effect, including shadow, from DELTARUNE (Chapter 5) by Toby Fox.
effect.author: Foxioo, (Recreation of an effect from a DELTARUNE created by Toby Fox)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Deltarune Lighting System With Shadow (Texture) Shader | 2026.11.28 */
parameter.description: This is a recreation of the lighting effect, including shadow, from DELTARUNE (Chapter 5) by Toby Fox.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Light Position X
parameter.description: This variable defines the position of the light source on the X-axis.

parameter.name: Light Position Y
parameter.description: This variable defines the position of the light source on the Y-axis.

parameter.name: Offset Shadow X
parameter.description: This variable defines the shadow offset along the X-axis.

parameter.name: Offset Shadow Y
parameter.description: This variable defines the shadow offset along the Y-axis.

parameter.name: Footer Position
parameter.description: This variable defines an offset for the point where the shadow begins; for example, if your sprite has 2 empty pixels from the bottom edge along the Y-axis, set this variable to 2-otherwise, there will be a gap between the shadow and the "feet."

parameter.name: Color Light
parameter.description: This variable determines the color of the light.

parameter.name: Color Shadow
parameter.description: This variable determines the color of the shadow.

parameter.name: Alpha Shadow
parameter.description: This variable defines the color of the alpha shadow.

parameter.name: Max Rim Offset
parameter.description: This variable defines the maximum limit of the rim light position.

parameter.name: Rim Offset Multiply
parameter.description: This variable multiplies the current position of the rim light.
